overview.text: Exgentic's Open Agent Leaderboard compares general-purpose agent systems across personal assistance, customer service, research, software engineering and technical support. The site publishes quality and cost results, a downloadable dataset and an evaluation repository. Its FAQ describes sampled benchmark tasks and warns that model changes and nondeterminism can affect reproduction. Rankings therefore retain the limits of the tested agent/model versions, task samples and evaluation setup rather than guaranteeing performance on every workload. Published results and reproduction materials are not an independent reproduction here.
